title: russian_pack
description:
A dark-themed resource pack that retextures a few vanilla items with custom, stylized designs.
Visual changes only, with no gameplay impact.
body:
This resource pack retextures several vanilla items with a dark, stylized theme.

Changes include:
• Golden Apple
• Golden Carrot
• Ender Pearl

All textures are custom-made and purely visual.
No gameplay changes, no advantages.

This pack is intended as a parody / stylized redesign and does not promote real-world products or substances.

Created by Xcromsd
